text:
maya: Quick thread 1 
Where should the bulk download live and how do we show the token breakdown legend? Two sketches in Figma.
devin: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/NEWDESIGN  Option A: prominent header 'Download invoice' + compact token legend to the right. Option B: header overflow bulk action + per-row icons + legend below chart.
pm_liu: Finance/legal: must be a clear top-level place for official invoices. They prefer header-level CTA for Org scope.
soph: UX: per-row icons are useful for teams, but they add noise at scale. Could hide them behind a row kebab/menu on mobile.
a11y-bot: Accessibility note: both legend and download controls need programmatic labels. Legend should use text keys, not color-only indicators. Download buttons need aria-labels like "Download invoice for Project X".
devin: Idea: show header CTA for Org scope (label: "Download invoice"), and show a lightweight per-row 'Export' icon for Project scope. Add a header overflow item 'Download visible' for bulk exports of rows in view.
maya: Token legend: show token count + USD for each series, e.g., "12.3K tokens (~$1.24)". On narrow screens move legend under chart.
pm_liu: Agree on CTAs copy: use 'Invoice' for PDF (official). For CSV use 'Export CSV'. Legal will review bulk export wording.
soph: Perf note: per-row download link requires invoice metadata per project. Let's lazy-load metadata for visible rows only and provide a batch endpoint for the bulk action.
infra-bot: infra-bot: created ticket INF-901 for batch invoice metadata + caching.
a11y-bot: Also ensure scope toggle announces changes: role=tablist + aria-selected on each tab, and use aria-live region for download completion to announce "Invoice(s) downloaded".
devin: On desktop right-legend keeps chart wide; on tablet legend goes below. Added collapsible legend in mock to give users control.
maya: Decision: implement header-level primary CTA when Org selected. Project scope shows per-row export (lazy) + header overflow bulk for visible rows. Legend flows responsive: right on desktop, below on mobile. Add explicit microcopy under CTA: "Official invoice (PDF). CSV exports available per project." 
pm_liu: I'll confirm legal microcopy but that sounds fine.
soph: Dev estimate: frontend ~2d to add header CTA + lazy per-row; backend ~1d for batch endpoint. Will link tickets after infra confirms.
maya: Action items: devin update figma with responsive states + microcopy; infra add link to ticket; a11y-bot to add acceptance criteria; pm_liu to confirm legal. Marking design-ready after links.
a11y-bot: a11y-bot: flagged missing focus order for bulk action in header overflow; add keyboard trap tests.
